repairs.C2-B-1: The independent validator now pins fixed SHA-256 digests for the complete authorization document, every transition semantic field, outcome branches, accounting, activation, supersession, paths, serialization, measurement, and artifact authority. Coordinated model regeneration cannot preserve PASS.
repairs.C2-B-2: Candidate and installed authorization artifacts now carry exactly the canonical authorization-document identity set and no generic bindings channel.
repairs.C2-B-3: Candidate and installed authorization identity paths are exact-equal. Candidate-validation report SHAs are introduced only after candidate serialization and are bound by the installation receipt, not authorization bytes.
repairs.C2-B-4: Every artifact has an explicit self-SHA identity. Candidate SHA is excluded from candidate and installed authorization bytes and first binds in validation and installation evidence.
repairs.C2-B-5: Outcome authority is variant-based: exact terminal branches and one distinct failure variant for every transition preserve the exact durable prefix, path state, ledger deltas, and forbidden remainder.
repairs.C2-N-1: The full artifact schema, payload census, self-SHA mapping, path descriptor census, and payload-to-binding equality surface is independently hash-anchored.
repairs.C2-N-2: Forbidden artifacts are now the complete artifact-class complement for every terminal and transition-failure variant.
repairs.C2-N-3: The entire path authority including exact roles, relation values, and all 36 root pairs is independently hash-anchored.
repairs.C2-N-4: The complete readback sequence and implementation-measurement semantics are independently hash-anchored.
repairs.C2-D-1: One exact artifact-file validation authority applies to all 29 artifact descriptors.
repairs.C2-D-2: Candidate and installed authorization descriptors are explicitly exposed by the interface; canonical install path must equal the installed descriptor.
repairs.C2-D-3: Registry grammars, identity record key census, type, grammar, source, and mismatch semantics are independently validated.
repairs.C2-D-4: Start-transition semantics are independently anchored and the unreachable evidence-banking terminal state was removed.
repairs.C2-D-5: Permanent mutations now exercise independent fixed anchors rather than relying on no-op mutation tautologies.
